groups.name: hitorro
groups.description: Configuration properties for Hitorro Spring Boot integration.

groups.name: hitorro.structured-logging
groups.description: Configuration for structured logging with Kafka integration.

properties.name: hitorro.enabled
properties.description: Whether Hitorro integration should be enabled.

properties.name: hitorro.services.enabled
properties.description: Whether to auto-configure Hitorro services.

properties.name: hitorro.services.startup-scripts
properties.description: Path to startup scripts to execute after service initialization.

properties.name: hitorro.services.db-init
properties.description: Whether to perform database initialization on startup.

properties.name: hitorro.dms.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable DMS integration.

properties.name: hitorro.dms.session-scope
properties.description: Scope for DMSSession beans: request, session, or prototype.

properties.name: hitorro.dms.transaction-mode
properties.description: Transaction mode: spring-managed or hitorro-native.

properties.name: hitorro.commands.rest.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable REST endpoints for command execution.

properties.name: hitorro.commands.rest.base-path
properties.description: Base path for command REST endpoints.

properties.name: hitorro.cli.native-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Hitorro's native CLI (telnet/SSH).

properties.name: hitorro.cli.telnet-port
properties.description: Port for telnet CLI access.

properties.name: hitorro.cli.ssh-port
properties.description: Port for SSH CLI access.

properties.name: hitorro.cli.spring-shell-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring Shell integration.

properties.name: hitorro.cli.actuator-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Actuator endpoint for commands.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.enabled
properties.description: Whether structured logging is enabled.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.kafka-bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Kafka bootstrap servers for log publishing.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.config-path
properties.description: Path to log configuration directory or classpath resource.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.enable-console-fallback
properties.description: Enable console fallback logging when Kafka is unavailable.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.linger-ms
properties.description: Kafka producer linger time in milliseconds.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.batch-size
properties.description: Kafka producer batch size in bytes.

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.compression-type
properties.description: Compression type for Kafka messages (none, gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd).

properties.name: hitorro.structured-logging.async-publishing
properties.description: Enable async publishing for non-blocking operation.
